items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
items.claim: The LORD commands Moses to stretch his hand over the sea so the waters will return upon the Egyptians, their chariots, and horsemen
items.object: the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen
